newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Volker wins Dfl 400 mln state order - TV.
newsitem.headline: Volker wins Dfl 400 mln state order - TV.

text.p: Dutch construction firm Koninklijke Volker Stevin NV said on Wednesday it had won a 400 million guilder order from the Dutch state as part of a major infrastructural project to re-develop a Hague suburb.
Finance director Pim Dijkman told Financial Times Television in an interview that the project involved a tunnel complex and the building of up to 700 housing units in Voorburg.
No-one at Volker Stevin was immediately available to confirm the figures.
Dutch Transport Minister Anne-Marie Jorritsma was due to announce the commissioning of the project at a news conference at 1130 GMT in The Hague.
